name: com.timemap.gameplay
description: Progression timeline for game designers: fabula, plot, skills, locations, upgrades and level curve on one game-time axis, a game slice at any moment, dependency validation, and saves / Play Mode from any point in time.

samples.description: 20-hour campaign with quest assets, a custom save format with Play Mode bootstrap and a custom validation rule.
Session-based castle with custom ability/boss tracks, an ability requirement, a track drawer and a slice card.
